title: Preserve the exact initial independence boundary in a coherent decoder
statement: All logical-to-reference wedge amplitudes are intertwiners. A jointly correlated junk state independent of logical inputs/references may leave an input-independent residual after successful extraction when the sameVacts on all slots. One-call encoder marginals do not supply this premise for an interacting source memory; IIDdeterminant yield is a separate claim.
